name: stoclaw
description: S Claw - Graphical AI Assistant based on OpenClaw
author: S Claw Team

scripts.init: pnpm install && pnpm run uv:download && pnpm run py:deps
scripts.predev: zx scripts/bundle-gateway-preload.mjs && zx scripts/sync-plugin-shared.mjs && zx scripts/ensure-openclaw-dev.mjs && zx scripts/prepare-preinstalled-skills-dev.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run uv:download:all && pnpm run dws:manifest && pnpm run bundle:gateway-preload && pnpm run sync:plugin-shared && vite build && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw-plugins.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-preinstalled-skills.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.prep:win-binaries: pnpm run prep:win-deps && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import ./.node-preload.mjs" pnpm run uv:download:win && pnpm run node:download:win
scripts.package: pnpm run dws:manifest && pnpm run bundle:gateway-preload && pnpm run sync:plugin-shared && vite build && pnpm run typecheck:chat-ui && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw-plugins.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-preinstalled-skills.mjs
scripts.package:test: pnpm run dws:manifest && pnpm run bundle:gateway-preload && pnpm run sync:plugin-shared && cross-env VITE_APP_ENV=test vite build --mode test && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw-plugins.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-preinstalled-skills.mjs
scripts.package:staging: pnpm run dws:manifest && pnpm run bundle:gateway-preload && pnpm run sync:plugin-shared && cross-env VITE_APP_ENV=staging vite build --mode staging && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-openclaw-plugins.mjs && zx scripts/bundle-preinstalled-skills.mjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run uv:download:mac && pnpm run package && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:mac:test: pnpm run uv:download:mac && pnpm run package:test && cross-env BUILD_ENV=test electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:mac:staging: pnpm run uv:download:mac && pnpm run package:staging && cross-env BUILD_ENV=staging electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:mac:local: pnpm run uv:download:mac && SKIP_PREINSTALLED_SKILLS=1 pnpm run package && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:win: pnpm run gen:win-installer-env && pnpm run prep:win-binaries && pnpm run package && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:win:test: cross-env BUILD_ENV=test pnpm run gen:win-installer-env && pnpm run prep:win-binaries && pnpm run package:test && cross-env BUILD_ENV=test electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:win:staging: cross-env BUILD_ENV=staging pnpm run gen:win-installer-env && pnpm run prep:win-binaries && pnpm run package:staging && cross-env BUILD_ENV=staging electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run uv:download:linux && pnpm run package && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:linux:test: pnpm run uv:download:linux && pnpm run package:test && cross-env BUILD_ENV=test electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:linux:staging: pnpm run uv:download:linux && pnpm run package:staging && cross-env BUILD_ENV=staging electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release: pnpm run uv:download:all && pnpm run package && electron-builder --publish always --config electron-builder.config.js
